description: HAL USART1 with DMA: TX by DMA1 channel 4, RX by DMA1 channel 5 into a circular 32-byte ring with IDLE detection (HAL_UARTEx_ReceiveToIdle_DMA); every received chunk is echoed as '<idle|ht|tc> <n>: <bytes>'
expect: 72 MHz, USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1 (BRR 0x271). TX: HAL_UART_Transmit_DMA on DMA1 channel 4 (memory to peripheral, bytes, normal); the next line is formatted only after the previous transmission completed (TC interrupt). RX: DMA1 channel 5 (peripheral to memory, bytes, circular) into a 32-byte ring via HAL_UARTEx_ReceiveToIdle_DMA; reception events are the DMA half transfer (ring position 16), transfer complete (position 32, wrap) and USART IDLE (line idle one frame after a byte). First TX 'uart-dma ready\r\n'. Each event echoes the bytes received since the previous event as '<idle|ht|tc> <n>: <bytes>\r\n' (n = byte count), its first byte about 60 us + one frame after the event; lines follow each other with ~50 us gaps. From a fresh start: 'hello' -> 'idle 5: hello'; a 40-byte burst -> 'ht 16: <bytes 1-16>', 'tc 16: <bytes 17-32>', 'idle 8: <bytes 33-40>'. The ring position carries over between bursts.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

scenarios.name: a short burst ends with an IDLE event
40 bytes: half transfer, transfer complete (wrap), then IDLE
